events.event: Kemenhub reports forest-fire smoke has disrupted 2,458 domestic flights at 29 airports since 11 Aug, up from 2,021 on 13 Oct.
events.key_numbers: 2,458 domestic flights affected (1,080 delayed · 1,324 cancelled/postponed · 22 diverted) · 29 airports · +437 since 13 Oct · 14 international flights cancelled (Singapore–Pontianak/Palembang) · 22 perintis flights cancelled 16 Oct · period 11 Aug–17 Oct 2026
events.why_it_matters: Haze is now hitting ordinary travel plans across Sumatra, Kalimantan, Sulawesi, Maluku and Papua.

events.event: BMKG satellite shows forest-fire smoke from Kalimantan and Sumatra reaching Banten, West Java and Jakarta; Governor Pramono puts Jakarta hospitals and puskesmas on standby.
events.key_numbers: 31 hospitals · 44 puskesmas · 292 puskesmas pembantu on standby · BMKG image released 16 Oct 10:00 · air quality worse for 2-3 days (Pramono) · BMKG: satellite smoke does not equal ground-level PM2.5; Liputan6 18 Oct: Jakarta air still unhealthy in some areas though smoke moving away
events.why_it_matters: The haze is no longer a Kalimantan/Sumatra problem; Java's biggest city is breathing it.

events.event: Malaysian PM Anwar Ibrahim says Indonesian haze has harmed health and closed schools in some Malaysian states, proposes an ASEAN haze mechanism and offers help.
events.key_numbers: 'tens of thousands' of Indonesian personnel deployed (Anwar) · school closures in some Malaysian states (no count)
events.why_it_matters: Transboundary haze becomes a diplomatic issue for Indonesia with Malaysia and Singapore.

events.event: MUI Deputy Chair Cholil Nafis calls the fires at 'emergency' level, urges Prabowo to prioritise them and asks for firm law enforcement against land burners, citing MUI Fatwa 30/2016 (burning forests is haram).
events.why_it_matters: Religious authority joins pressure on government; adds to Golkar call for national-disaster status (E0034).

events.event: CELIOS estimates Jan–Aug 2026 karhutla losses of Rp39.29–123.1 T depending on how health costs are counted; BNPB still fighting 639.23 ha in six priority provinces as of 13 Oct.
events.key_numbers: Total Rp39.29–123.1 T · physical/economic Rp29.54 T · ISPA health cost Rp9.75 T (diagnosed, ~1.78 M people) to Rp93.56 T (broad) · Central Kalimantan loss ≈49.1% of its 2026 PDRB · regional tax revenue risk up to Rp269.86 miliar · ~202,010 ha burned nationally (Aug data) · 639.23 ha active, Tanjung Puting 513.89 ha
events.why_it_matters: Puts a rupiah figure on the haze; strong numbers for an explainer.

events.event: BRIN researcher explains why peat and forest fires are so hard to put out: underground smouldering, limited water bombing, smoke blocking aerial work; recommends keeping peat wet and holding concession holders accountable.
events.key_numbers: Source: Yayan Hadiyan, BRIN Pusat Riset Ekologi
events.why_it_matters: Explains to ordinary people why the fires keep burning despite thousands of personnel.

events.event: Anak Krakatau erupts 8 times on 18 Oct, ash up to 500 m; stays at Level III (Siaga).
events.key_numbers: 8 eruptions · ash 100–500 m above summit (657 m asl) · no entry within 5 km, 1 km of new islands
events.why_it_matters: Confirms the Level III status is active, with eruptions continuing.

events.event: Bahlil says Pertalite stock has dropped to 16-18 days (norm 20) as drivers shift from Pertamax to cheaper Pertalite; target back to 20 days within about a week.
events.key_numbers: Pertalite 16–18 days vs 20-day norm · recovery ≈1 week · Pertalite Rp10,000 vs Pertamax Rp15,950 (E0005)
events.why_it_matters: Fuel-stock worries are a daily-life issue; also fuels hoaxes about Pertalite.

events.event: Government postpones mandatory halal certification phases that were due 18 Oct 2026, to 2028 for most food, beverage and consumer products (revision of PP 42/2024).
events.key_numbers: Food/beverage/slaughter services: 18 Oct 2028 · micro-small businesses: 17 Oct 2028 · cosmetics, herbal, supplements etc.: 17 Oct 2028 · OTC drugs: 17 Oct 2029 · prescription drugs: 17 Oct 2034 · BPJPH Reg 4/2026 on foreign products to be revoked
events.why_it_matters: Affects every food seller and consumer product maker, especially small businesses.

events.event: Bharada Valdo is shot and stabbed to death at Polairud HQ, Pondok Cabe, South Tangerang; fellow Bharada Andika Rahmadani is detained; on 19 Oct Menko Polkam Dudung says Polri recruitment and psychological screening will be evaluated and Komisi III urges mental tests for armed officers.
events.key_numbers: Incident 16 Oct ~04:40 WIB · motive unconfirmed (alleged bullying per initial report/family lawyer; family suspects premeditation) · Polda Metro Jaya investigating
events.why_it_matters: Raises questions about firearms control and mental screening in the police, amid the Polri leadership reshuffle.

events.event: Former Polri international relations chief Irjen (Purn) Napoleon Bonaparte dies of illness; buried in Cikeas on 19 Oct.
events.key_numbers: Died 18 Oct 10:32 WIB · convicted 2021 in Djoko Tjandra Interpol red-notice bribery case, 4 years · paroled Apr 2023
events.why_it_matters: Closes a chapter of one of Indonesia's best-known police corruption cases; heavily read today.

events.event: Detik reports lawyer Kamaruddin Simanjuntak (known for the Ferdy Sambo case) has died after illness involving repeated dialysis hospital visits.
events.key_numbers: Detik 'terpopuler' #1 and #2 on 19 Oct (~11:30–13:30 WIB); family earlier denied a death rumour (undated)
events.why_it_matters: Top-read story; check before using given earlier false rumour.

events.event: East Jakarta court hears interlocutory ruling in Roy Suryo's slander/ITE trial over Jokowi's diploma; Detik headline says the defence objection (nota perlawanan/eksepsi) was rejected and Roy Suryo asked Jokowi to show the original diploma at trial.
events.key_numbers: Hearing 19 Oct 09:00 WIB, PN Jakarta Timur · charges: fitnah, pencemaran nama baik, ITE · prosecution called 'fake 99.9%' claim a matter for trial
events.why_it_matters: Case moves to evidence stage; diploma disputes (Jokowi, Gibran) remain top political talk.

events.event: Komisi II DPR member Ahmad Doli Kurnia says Komisi II will review the alleged 'pasal selundupan' in PKPU 19/2023 (Pasal 18(3)) that exempts candidates with a university degree from showing a foreign high-school diploma; critics link it to Gibran's 2024 candidacy.
events.key_numbers: PKPU 19/2023 Pasal 18(3) and 13(1)r · UU 7/2017 Pasal 169r · remarks 18 Oct; MK hearing 1 Oct; ex-KPU chair Hasyim Asy'ari denies engineering
events.why_it_matters: The Gibran diploma issue shifts from the MK ruling to a parliamentary review of KPU rules.

events.event: KPK probes the role of Klaten regent Hamenang Wajar Ismoyo's younger brother, who kept a blue barrel with Rp934 juta; funds allegedly mix procurement bribes, OPD/BUMD gratuities and quarry income; BPK Central Java audit-fixing cluster.
events.key_numbers: Rp934 juta in barrel · ~Rp1.9 miliar total cash seized · two other suspects · regent detained 16 Oct · May 2026 BPK audit report allegedly omitted findings
events.why_it_matters: Visual detail (money in a blue barrel) with a BPK audit-bribery angle.

events.event: Cek Fakta Liputan6: viral claim that Prabowo is closing the MBG free-meal programme due to an economic crisis is a hoax; the fake Kompas headline does not exist and BGN has made no such announcement.
events.key_numbers: Facebook post 18 Oct · Finance Minister Suahasil 9 Oct: efficiency, not budget cut · other recent hoaxes: Pertalite price to Rp13,500 (24 Sep post), 'Pertalite sachet powder' (13 Oct), fake Jasa Marga job link
events.why_it_matters: Fake news around MBG and fuel prices spreads fast during economic worries.

events.event: PPI survey finds 65.4% of respondents satisfied with the Prabowo government, ahead of the 2-year mark on 20 Oct (contrasts with SMRC 51.1% cited in E0036).
events.why_it_matters: Conflicting polls will frame the 2-year anniversary debate.
